artifact.note: RC-3 did not regenerate or re-sign the artifact. The hash is historical RC-2 evidence, not a new measurement.

tools.stapler: present on PATH but unusable; requires full Xcode

configured.identity: not set in electron-builder.yml; electron-builder searches the keychain

gatekeeper.reason: Last observed artifact was adhoc and failed codesign --verify. No sealed Developer ID artifact is on disk. spctl cannot produce a meaningful accept result until signing and notarization exist.
prerequisiteChain: hardened-runtime signed and sealed .app, including nested Electron helpers

notarization.workflow: electron-builder notarize integration after a Developer ID signature. Preferred credential path is App Store Connect API key via APPLE_API_KEY, APPLE_API_KEY_ID, APPLE_API_ISSUER. Alternate path is APPLE_ID, APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID. Record the notarytool submission id and staple result. Do not store credentials in source.

wireguard.architecture: arm64 host; helper source is platform-generic TypeScript, no compiled arm64 helper binary in the tree
wireguard.privilege: SMAppService privileged helper, socket mode 0600, root-owned
wireguard.signing: Developer ID Application on app and helper, same team, hardened runtime, notarized, SMPrivilegedExecutables/SMAuthorizedClients requirements

oauth.nonce: not implemented as a separate OIDC nonce
oauth.tokenStorage: Electron safeStorage via SecureStorage key drive:tokens:<profileId>
oauth.syntheticTestRequired: Google OAuth client restricted to loopback redirect, plus a synthetic Google account. Credentials injected only as process environment, never in source.

ollama.featureGated: default local AI provider; offline is an honest state
ollama.minimumTest: service up, synthetic non-PHI model available, status CONNECTED only after a real response

googleDrive.minimumTest: live loopback OAuth with a synthetic account, then one Drive metadata call; cancelled login must not authenticate

openai.featureGated: NOT_CONFIGURED until a key is stored in safeStorage
openai.config: operator-entered key, not an environment variable
openai.minimumTest: synthetic key, GET /v1/models returns real CONNECTED; absent key stays NOT_CONFIGURED

anthropic.featureGated: NOT_CONFIGURED until a key is stored in safeStorage
anthropic.config: operator-entered key, not an environment variable
anthropic.minimumTest: synthetic key, GET /v1/models returns real CONNECTED; absent key stays NOT_CONFIGURED

permissions.liveTest: In the packaged app, request each class in a real page. Expect deny with no grant for the denied list. Expect grant without a consent dialog for the allowed list. Do not edit the OS permission database.

gui.requiredArtifact: sealed Developer ID signed and notarized dist/mac-arm64/NEXA.app
gui.syntheticData: two profiles named Profile-A and Profile-B; marker tab text only; no personal accounts

securityPreservation.note: Existing Electron hardened-runtime entitlements are packaging configuration. This plan does not add entitlements, disable Gatekeeper, or disable hardened runtime.

nextActions: Do not start a git repository in the product tree unless a separate source-control decision is made. Record SOURCE_COMMIT_UNAVAILABLE until a real commit exists.
Install full Xcode and point xcode-select at it so stapler and xcodebuild work. notarytool is already present via Command Line Tools.
Obtain a Developer ID Application certificate for the distribution team. Do not use the Apple Development identity as the release signature. Inject it with CSC_NAME or CSC_LINK outside source.
Obtain notarization credentials outside source, preferably APPLE_API_KEY, APPLE_API_KEY_ID, and APPLE_API_ISSUER.
Run the existing package:mac script only in a later phase, after the identity is present. Expect dist/mac-arm64/NEXA.app plus DMG and ZIP. Do not treat an adhoc app as the release artifact.
Sign nested Electron helpers and frameworks through electron-builder. Do not stop at the main executable.
Notarize the DMG or ZIP, record the notarytool submission id, staple, then run codesign --verify --deep --strict and spctl -a -vvv -t install. Do not disable Gatekeeper.
Grant the operator screen recording and assistive access, then execute the GUI, private-mode, profile-isolation, negative-navigation, and live permission procedures on that sealed artifact.
For WireGuard, separately build and Developer ID-sign the helper, install it with SMAppService, and install system wg and wg-quick. Do not bundle an unsigned helper or simulate a tunnel.

For optional features only: provide loopback Google OAuth credentials and a synthetic account, start Ollama, and enter synthetic OpenAI/Anthropic keys through the app secure-storage path. Their absence is not a core browser failure, but it still leaves those RC-2 items BLOCKED.
